snippets.name: Certificate of a server
snippets.body: echo | openssl s_client -connect {{host}}:{{port:443|8443|636|993}} -servername {{host}} 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -ext subjectAltName

snippets.name: Days until a server's certificate expires
Does the key match the certificate?
Self-signed certificate for tests
snippets.body: openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -nodes -days 30 -keyout test.key -out test.crt -subj '/CN=localhost'

snippets.name: SSH host key fingerprints
snippets.body: for f in /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub; do ssh-keygen -lf "$f"; done
